scenarios.name: UHT temperature drop
scenarios.description: Steam dips: the plant diverts, cleans and re-sterilizes for 113 min while the fillers drain the tank.

scenarios.name: Filler breakdown
scenarios.description: A filler stops for an hour; the aseptic tank fills up and the UHT plant slows down.

scenarios.name: Sterile-air filter failure
scenarios.description: A process deviation: the batches filled meanwhile are held for investigation.

scenarios.name: Failed incubation
scenarios.description: A blown pack at the incubator check blocks the oldest batch on hold.

scenarios.name: Homogenizer pressure loss
scenarios.description: Stage 1 falls to 50 bar for an hour; a week later the sensory check finds cream.

scenarios.name: Demand spike
scenarios.description: Twelve extra trucks in an hour: stock runs down and trucks queue in the yard.

scenarios.name: Late trucks
scenarios.description: No truck for almost 7 hours, then four at once: the dock backs up.

scenarios.name: Slow fermentation (phage)
scenarios.description: A bacteriophage stalls a tank at pH 5.2: it is flagged 2 h late, held, then discarded; the next tank feeds P8.

scenarios.name: Yogurt heat treatment under temperature
scenarios.description: The holding cell's outlet falls below 85 °C: the mix diverts to the reprocess tank, the wing cleans the line, then it runs again.

scenarios.name: Seal temperature drift
scenarios.description: P8's seal heads drift below 180 °C: the next seal test fails, the cups since the last pass are held, and the batch goes to QA.

scenarios.name: HEPA overpressure loss
scenarios.description: P8's cabin falls below +15 Pa: P8 stops, and after the repair needs a new SIP and ATP swab before it restarts.

scenarios.name: Cold-room excursion
scenarios.description: The cold room warms past 6 °C for 2 h: its pallets go on hold, and QA releases or destroys them.
